stories.headline: Israel's president picks Eisenkot, not Netanyahu, to form a government
body: President Isaac Herzog has asked opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot to form Israel's next government.
67 lawmakers, including Arab-led parties, backed Eisenkot; 46 backed Netanyahu.
The former army chief now has 28 days to build a coalition.
stories.joke: 28 days to build a coalition. Israel's version of a group project.
stories.vc: A change of government could reshape Israel's budget, defence spending and foreign investment mood.

stories.statLabel: litres of Russian diesel delivered to US
stories.headline: Russian diesel tankers bound for the US turn back
body: At least three tankers carrying Russian diesel to the US have changed course.
No diesel has arrived under Trump's October deal with Putin, as buyers fear legal action.
A US ban on Russian energy imports passed by Congress is still in place.
stories.joke: A deal so good nobody will touch it.
stories.vc: With US diesel prices nearly doubled since the Iran war began, failed supply deals keep fuel costs high.

stories.headline: Ousted Paraguay president placed under house arrest
body: Santiago Peña was impeached and placed under house arrest after the collapse of Ueno Bank.
He was a shareholder in the digital bank, which served about 3 million people, more than half the country's adults.
Millions still can't reach their money.
stories.vc: A fintech collapse this big will push regulators everywhere to look harder at digital banks.

stories.headline: Indian startup stocks rally; CarTrade jumps 23%
body: 54 of 69 listed new-age tech stocks rose this week, Inc42 data shows.
Their combined value rose 5.2% to $169.3 billion, as foreign investors bought again.
CarTrade led with 23.3%, while Lenskart, Nykaa and Ather hit 52-week highs.
stories.joke: Startup stocks finally remembered they're growth stocks.
stories.vc: A strong run for listed startups makes it easier for OYO and others to launch IPOs.

stories.headline: Indian startups raised $255M this week, nearly double last week
body: 20 Indian startups raised $255 million between 2 and 6 November, up 96% from the week before.
But the number of deals fell 38%.
GIVA's $103 million round made e-commerce the top-funded sector.
stories.joke: More money, fewer cheques. VCs are being picky.
stories.vc: Bigger but fewer deals means investors are backing proven winners over new bets.

stories.headline: Karnataka finds up to 31% ethanol in petrol meant to be 20%
body: Karnataka says lab tests found up to 31.2% ethanol in petrol meant to have 20%.
Samples came from IOCL and HPCL pumps in Bengaluru and five other districts.
The state says this raises questions about transparency for drivers.
stories.joke: Your car ordered 20% ethanol and got a large.
stories.vc: If confirmed, blend problems could affect engine warranties and oil companies' reputations.

stories.headline: Defence tech firm Shield AI tops the week with $2B raise
body: Shield AI, which builds autonomy software for defence, raised $2 billion, the week's largest round.
Zipline was second with $1.5 billion.
AI, defence and space startups led the week's big deals, Crunchbase says.
stories.joke: Peace talks are slow; defence funding isn't.
stories.vc: Defence tech has become one of venture capital's biggest bets this year.

stories.headline: Space startup CesiumAstro raises $730M
body: CesiumAstro, which builds satellites and space communications for defence, raised a $730 million Series D.
It is now valued at over $4.5 billion.
It also got $100 million in debt from the US Export-Import Bank and JP Morgan.
stories.joke: Space is the new office park.
stories.vc: Big rounds for satellite makers show investors expect steady government contracts.

stories.headline: Applied Compute raises $350M at a $3.25B valuation
body: Applied Compute, a cloud platform for training and running big AI models, raised $350 million.
Elad Gil led the round, with Nvidia among investors.
The 18-month-old company says yearly revenue already tops $100 million.
stories.joke: Eighteen months old and already earning nine figures. Show-off.
stories.vc: AI compute is still drawing huge sums, even as some data shows AI spending slowing.

stories.headline: Midterm voters reject data centres in dozens of local votes
body: Voters rejected data centres in dozens of local ballot measures in this week's US midterms.
Texas' governor-elect campaigned on restricting them.
TechCrunch's Equity podcast says it is a rocky moment for Elon Musk's companies too.
stories.joke: Everyone loves AI until it moves in next door.
stories.vc: Local pushback could slow the AI build-out and raise costs for chip and power investors.

stories.headline: Binance's finance chief leaves after $6.3B hack
body: Binance CFO Kaiser Ng is leaving the crypto exchange to start a new venture.
It comes just over a week after hackers stole $6.3 billion from Binance users.
Binance says it will cover all losses itself.
stories.vc: Leadership changes after a record hack will test trust in the world's biggest crypto exchange.

stories.headline: Delhi HC orders AAP to remove AI videos of CM Rekha Gupta
body: The Delhi High Court ordered AAP to take down AI-made videos of Chief Minister Rekha Gupta.
The court said the posts were defamatory and attacked the dignity of a woman in constitutional office.
One deepfake showed her pouring liquor.
stories.vc: Court action on political deepfakes raises pressure on X and Meta to act faster on takedowns.

stories.headline: Rajasthan police rescue six girls forced into prostitution
body: Police in Rajasthan's Jhalawar district rescued six minor girls from a prostitution racket.
Five people, including relatives of the girls, were arrested.
A complaint said families from a denotified tribe were pushing girls into the trade.
stories.vc: Rescue is only step one; rehabilitation needs funding for shelters, schooling and health care.

stories.headline: Women voted on prices. Now Congress must deliver
body: Women swung hard towards Democrats in an election shaped by the cost of living, The 19th reports.
Women make most household purchases and worry more about health care, housing and grocery costs.
More mothers than ever will serve in the new Congress.
stories.vc: Childcare and health costs are now top policy fights, with big stakes for insurers and care providers.

stories.headline: Chennai's Dr Agarwal's adds 39 eye centres
body: Chennai-based Dr Agarwal's Health Care added 39 eye centres in six months, taking its network to 324.
Quarterly revenue rose 31% to ₹655 crore, and profit rose 56% to ₹57 crore.
It did nearly 96,000 surgeries in the quarter.
stories.vc: Eye-care chains grow fast because surgeries like cataract removal are frequent and predictable.

stories.headline: Aster's new hospitals grow 62% as occupancy rises
body: Bengaluru-based Aster DM's newer hospitals, including Kasaragod and Nagercoil, grew revenue 62%.
Overall revenue rose 19% to ₹2,829 crore, and occupancy climbed to 68%.
Medical tourism revenue jumped 36%, led by patients from the Maldives and the Gulf.
stories.vc: Patients from abroad are a growing profit source for South Indian hospital chains.

stories.statLabel: new PG seats in govt colleges
stories.headline: Maharashtra adds 1,066 specialist medical seats, 720 in govt colleges
body: Maharashtra now has 7,615 postgraduate medical seats after adding 1,066 in a year.
720 were added in government medical colleges in just five weeks.
The figures come from the NMC's latest seat list.
stories.vc: More specialist seats in public colleges means more doctors for government hospitals over time.

stories.headline: Norris takes pole in a soaking-wet Brazil qualifying
body: Lando Norris took pole for the Brazilian GP in heavy rain, beating George Russell by two tenths.
Russell drops five places for an engine change, and Leclerc ten.
That puts Racing Bulls' Liam Lawson third on the grid, with Antonelli second.
stories.joke: Rain delays: F1's way of adding a bonus hour.
stories.vc: F1 also signed Sao Paulo up until 2035, locking in a key Latin American market.
